notes:
Summary: Helm Vectoria runs an enterprise RAG platform for regulated verticals (financial/advisory). Primary pain: cost-per-query at scale + occasional quality regressions when swapping embedding models or reranker. They index ~120M documents (mostly long-form PDFs + transcripts) and are extremely sensitive to recall/precision tradeoffs — business impact when reranker downgrades top-3 answers.

Customer quotes from calls: "We can tolerate a small latency bump but not a loss in ranked relevance for top results. If an A/B swap causes user escalation we lose contracts."

Evals approach: customer wants Redwood to run their eval harness (5k labeled queries, acceptance thresholds per intent). They want auto-gating: block rollout if top-k MRR drops >2% or worst-case drop in compliance-extracted entities. Looking for embedded evals integration + canary traffic split tools.

Operational constraints: must support EU data residency for a subset of index shards, audit logs for all inference, SSO + SCIM. Prefer Dedicated pool with fallback to hosted during spikes. Interested in Optimize recommendations for batching/quantization to bring per-query cost down.

Sales tacticals: send dedicated pricing deck, sample eval report template, and a short runbook for canary rollback. Legal wants a draft data residency addendum.

Stated blockers: security sign-off pending, need 3rd-party benchmark vs current Weaviate+custom reranker.

Short notes (shorthand): "no-regression" = must pass evals; "canary-w-traffic" = 10% traffic for 2 weeks; "optimize-proto" = run model/quantization suggestions on 10k invocations.
index_size_estimate: ~120M documents / 18TB raw; shard residency split EU:40% US:60%
migration_plan: Phase 1: offline embedding respaces + eval runs; Phase 2: reranker A/B on 10% traffic (2 weeks); Phase 3: canary 50% then full rollout with rollback gating
acceptance_criteria: MRR top-3 drop <= 2%; paraphrase F1 delta <= 1.5%; no critical compliance entity misses in sample set
